newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Legend still in talks on business links.
newsitem.headline: Legend still in talks on business links.

text.p: Legend Holdings Ltd said on Wednesday it was still in talks with parent The New Technology Developer Inc Institute of Computing Technology Academia Sinica, on possible business cooperation.

"The discussions with the controlling shareholder of the company and its associates to explore opportunities of business cooperation in various areas are still in the preliminary stage and no agreement has been reached," Legend said in a statement.
The computer maker and distributor said in February it was in talks with its parent on business cooperation including the possibility of acquiring and/or merging certain businesses.
Legend shares ended HK$0.03 higher at HK$1.85 on Wednesday.
